basic_info.description: Tucked behind an unassuming facade, this reimagined 3BD/2.5BA detached home is a serene retreat in a park-like setting, blending privacy & city living. Set on a rare double-deep lot, it boasts lush landscaping, multiple outdoor spaces & seamless indoor-outdoor flow. Inside, an open-concept design w/expansive windows floods the space w/natural light & verdant views. High-end finishes & sleek details create a sophisticated yet warm ambiance. The chef's kitchen, w/ample cabinet & counter space, flows into the airy living & dining areasideal  for quiet nights or lively gatherings. The luxe primary suite features a spa-like ensuite bath w/a soaking tub & large shower, leading to an expansive deck & lush yard. Two add'l bd share a stylish bath. Downstairs offers a 1/2 ba & w/d. Built w/the future in mind: new roof, plumbing, electrical, ductwork, water heater & central air furnace. Structural upgrades include a steel beam, new foundation & seismic retrofits. Smart home tech includes whole-house TV, CAT6 wiring, in-ceiling speakers, intercom & security system. Minutes to Bernal Hill, Cortland shops, Precita Park & easy access to 280/101, SFO & tech shuttlesthis home offers privacy, tranquility & modern convenience!
